episodes.title: Du ser ut som en slut
episodes.summary: Eva is in her first year at school, and has fallen out with her old friends Ingrid and Sara. She only knows her boyfriend Jonas and his friend Isak at school. She gets convinced to go to school party, where she meets several new people.

episodes.title: Jonas, dette er helt dust
episodes.summary: During fall holiday, Eva, Jonas and Isak go on a cabin trip. Eva is annoyed because her boyfriend invited Isak along. The tension between them rises when she suspects Jonas is keeping secrets.

episodes.title: Vi er de største loserne på skolen
episodes.summary: Back at school, Eva befriends Noora in her Spanish class. Them and Sana get invited by Vilde and Chris to join them in getting a bus for the graduation celebration when they become "russ" in three years.

episodes.title: Go for it din lille slut
episodes.summary: Sana and Vilde want Eva to get in touch with Christoffer to get them invited to a party with the third year boys, among them the most popular boy in school - William.

episodes.title: Hva er det som gjør deg kåt?
episodes.summary: Eva invites Jonas for dinner to meet her mom. Vilde is falling for William, and the girls visit the school doctor to get contraceptives for Vilde, after her decision to lose her virginity.

episodes.title: Man vet når gutter lyver
episodes.summary: Eva suspects that Jonas is cheating on her with her former friend Ingrid, and meets Isak to talk about it. Vilde reveals details about her and William. The girls go to a Halloween party Christoffer invited them to.

episodes.title: Tenker alltid det er meg det er noe gale med
episodes.summary: After kissing Christoffer on Halloween, Eva feels guilty and asks Isak for counsel. Noora wants Vilde to stand up for herself and stop caring for William, after he started ignoring her for other girls.

episodes.title: Hele skolen hater meg
episodes.summary: Everyone knows about what happened on Halloween, and the entire school is gossiping about Eva. Jonas won't talk to her, and on top of things Vilde finds out about Eva's past. William starts to show interest in Noora.

episodes.title: Man er det man gjør
episodes.summary: Eva gets a threatening letter, and Vilde decides to leave the bus crew. Eva is thinking about changing to another school, while trying to find out who wrote the letter.

episodes.title: Jeg tenker du har blitt helt psyko
episodes.summary: The girls start to worry that something is wrong with Vilde. Eva speaks with Jonas after not talking with him for a long time. The girls go to a Christmas party, and Eva decides to confront Isak.

episodes.title: Et jævlig dumt valg
episodes.summary: Vilde reveals that she might be pregnant. William continues to flirt with Noora. Isak and Eva have a talk, and Eva decides to have a heart-to-heart conversation with Jonas.

episodes.title: Om du bare hadde holdt det du lovet
episodes.summary: Noora and Vilde are in disagreement over sponsors for the bus. Noora's flatmates Eskild and Linn are introduced. Noora tries to avoid William, who has become very pushy in his advances towards her.

episodes.title: Du lyver til en venninne og skylder på meg
episodes.summary: Rumors about Eva's ex Jonas are spreading through school to her dismay. Sana experiences hostility from some of the other Muslim girls at school. Noora can't avoid going on a date she promised William any longer.

episodes.title: Er det noe du skjuler for oss?
episodes.summary: Noora tries to keep her and William's date a secret, especially from Vilde. Chris and other friends of William have been in a fight. William is hosting a large party in his apartment.

episodes.title: Jeg visste det var noe rart med henne
episodes.summary: During Easter holiday, Noora and the girls go to Chris' grandmother's cabin. On the way, they meet a weird boy named Kasper. They also play with an Ouija board and Vilde believes Sana has supernatural abilities.

episodes.title: Jeg er i hvert fall ikke sjalu
episodes.summary: Noora is worried that she doesn't care enough about the Syrian refugee crisis. William and his bus crew are raising money for trashing a cabin during Easter, and Noora calls him out on being egotistical.

episodes.title: Jeg vil ikke bli beskytta
episodes.summary: William's brother Nikolai has returned to Oslo, and Noora has problems with William not introducing her properly to him. The girls discuss the fact that Jonas has been beaten up. Noora and William witness a strange meeting.

episodes.title: Noora, du trenger pikk
episodes.summary: The russ celebration has begun. Noora is still keeping her and William's relationship secret from Vilde. Eskild takes on the case to find out if Isak is gay or not. The girls party with the third year boys in their bus.

episodes.title: Du tenker bare på William
episodes.summary: William tries to explain himself to Noora after he was involved in a fight. Sana gives Noora some advice, and Noora decides to come clean to Vilde. While looking for William, Noora ends up at Nikolai's party.

episodes.title: Jeg savner deg så jævlig
episodes.summary: Noora wakes up naked in bed with Nikolai not remembering anything from the day before, and suspects she has been raped. Sana's problems with the other Muslim girls gets worse.

episodes.title: Jeg skal forklare alt
episodes.summary: Eskild and Linn try to cheer Noora up, but she is still dealing with last Friday. Noora reluctantly goes to Eva's to celebrate May the 17th, the National Day. She also decides to confront Nikolai, to find out exactly what happened.

episodes.title: Husker du seriøst ingenting?
episodes.summary: Vilde visits Noora. Noora talks to one of the girls from Nikolai's party to find out the truth. William does not answer Noora's calls or messages, and hasn't been seen at school.

episodes.title: Vil du flytte sammen med meg?
episodes.summary: Noora and William go back to William's apartment, where he finds a letter from the police. William is wanted for questioning for hitting a boy with a bottle during a fight. Vilde and Noora try to make sure nobody witnesses against him.

episodes.title: Lykke til, Isak
episodes.summary: Isak has to hide the drugs belonging to him, Jonas, Mahdi and Magnus at Eva's party when the police arrive, and struggles to get them back. First year girl Emma shows interest in Isak. Isak joins the school revue group.

episodes.title: Du er over 18, sant?
episodes.summary: In class, Isak tries to get his drugs back from Sana. Isak is crushing on Even, and tries to find out more about him. Emma, still interested in Isak, invites Isak and the boys to a party at her place.

episodes.title: Nå bånder dere i overkant mye / Hun er på
episodes.summary: After ditching the party and lying, Isak has to make amends with his friends and Emma. Isak is struggling to come to terms with his homosexuality and interest in Even. Vilde gets Isak to throw a party for the school revue at his place.

episodes.title: Keen på å bade / Da vorser vi sammen?
episodes.summary: Noora returns from London without William, and Isak is wondering how living conditions in the flat will be with four people. Even talks Isak into having a Halloween pre-party with him, his girlfriend and Emma.

episodes.title: Samme tid et helt annet sted / Kan jeg bli her med deg for altid?
episodes.summary: Isak and Even spend time together, and talk about their relationship. Isak has to answer to his friends for ditching Magnus' birthday the weekend before. Isak and Eskild have a talk about homosexuality.

episodes.title: Escobar season / Kan du ikke bare si det?
episodes.summary: Emma is still angry at Isak, and Isak is not talking to Even either. Jonas reaches out and offers to talk with Isak about his issues. Because of sleep problems, Isak decides to go to the eccentric school doctor.

episodes.title: Er du homo?
episodes.summary: Even is sending Isak some confusing signals, and Isak asks Eskild for advice. Rumors that Isak might be gay are spreading through school. After coming out to Jonas, he encourages Isak to tell Mahdi and Magnus as well.

episodes.title: Mannen i mitt liv / Drit i å ringe Isak
episodes.summary: Isak's dad wants Isak to answer to him about going to a church concert with his mom and him. Sana reluctantly tries to tell Isak she was wrong in a previous discussion. Even surprises Isak by booking a hotel suite for them.

episodes.title: Det går over / Velkommen til mobilsvar
episodes.summary: After Even's manic episode, Isak does some research on bipolar disorder. Isak struggles getting in touch with Even. Magnus offers some good advice. Isak goes to a church concert with his parents.

episodes.title: Minutt for minutt / Jeg så deg første skoledag
episodes.summary: Isak has to take care of Even while he is in a period of depression, and get help from Eskild and the other flatmates. Isak hosts a Christmas party for the revue group after Vilde asks him to.

episodes.title: Du hater å henge med oss
episodes.summary: Sana struggles with being a practicing Muslim and hanging with her friends, especially Vilde discussing her sex life. Sana and the rest of the girls go to a party with Sana's brother Elias and his friends, Yousef, Mikael, Adam and Mutta.

episodes.title: Jeg er gutt, jeg får ikke hat
episodes.summary: Sana shows interest in Yousef, her brother's friend, and gets protective when Noora also shows interest. The girls get a lead on a bus for the Russ celebration. Sana and Vilde want to buy, but Noora thinks it is too expensive.

episodes.title: Hva mener du om drikking?
episodes.summary: Yousef helps Sana prepare dinner and they get to know each other better, and start flirting. Sara and Ingrid asks Sana if they are interested in combining their bus crews, and Sana has to host a bus meeting. Even has a question for Sana.

episodes.title: Allah hadde digget deg
episodes.summary: Noora reveals the truth about her breakup with William, whereafter Sana brings her along to meet new guys. Elias gets completely smashed, so Yousef calls Sana for help. On the way home, Yousef and Sana share some deep religious insights.

episodes.title: Hvis du er trist er jeg trist
episodes.summary: Sana suspects that Sara is hiding something from her. Sana's mother is worried about her recent behavior, which Sana finds very irritating. Elias then reaches out to Sana and gives her some advice. Everyone gathers for a karaoke party.

episodes.title: Har du en dårlig dag?
episodes.summary: Sana is furious about recent revelations, which are really getting to her. She tries to discreetly come up with a way to get revenge, but keeps getting distracted in her surroundings. Isak then tells a story, which gets her attention.

episodes.title: Vi må stå sammen
episodes.summary: Sana is having a hard time dealing with her feelings towards Yousef. She initiates a social media war, creating turbulence and disunity within the bus group. A surprise awaits Sana at home. Sana and Isak have a discussion.

episodes.title: De største loserne på skolen
episodes.summary: Sana becomes increasingly anxious about telling the girls the truth behind the Instagram account. By accident, she tells Eva the truth, whereafter Sana becomes devastated. Eva hosts a birthday party, which takes an interesting turn.

episodes.title: Livet smiler
episodes.summary: Sana worries about Noora being off radar with William. Noora encourages Sana to make a move on Yousef.

episodes.title: Takk for alt
episodes.summary: The point of view of several of the recurring characters are shown, and their lives are explored in the week leading up to Sana's party for Eid.
